title: Maintaining Integrity (Do/don’t)
slide_intent: Help designers recognize alterations that compromise the signature. A grid of counterexamples makes different failure modes easy to distinguish.
strategic_value: The lab can preserve a consistent silhouette and readable lettering by supplying a visual reference for common reproduction errors.
demonstration: Twelve examples vary the mark through stretching, repositioning, rotation, altered colors, decoration, images and poor contrast. Each has a short warning.
practical_value: Compare a draft mark with the specific error examples before releasing a slide, poster or other asset.

content_islands.name: Integrity rule
content_islands.spec: Set the reproduction guidance at upper left and the proportional-scaling note in orange below it.

content_islands.name: Error grid
content_islands.spec: Arrange twelve altered marks in three columns and four rows on a pale field. Keep each warning attached to its example so the prohibited alteration is identifiable.
